errors.text_span: The horizontal axis represents the optimisations applied... The vertical axis represents the difference in average WER
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the horizontal and vertical axes. In this horizontal bar chart, the vertical axis shows the categories ('Optimisations applied') and the horizontal axis shows the values ('Difference in Average WER...').
The value axis (horizontal axis) clearly starts at 0.000, not 0.002.
The labeled tick marks on the value axis are at 0.000, 0.001, 0.002, and 0.003, indicating an interval of 0.001, not 0.0005.
